nodes.label: The page
nodes.what: The standalone page around the map, `mountPage()`: breadcrumbs, search, menus, the details panel and the story recorder.
nodes.how: One key router reads each key from the top open layer down. One function writes the link from what the map shows, and another follows a link, on load and on Back or Forward.

nodes.label: MCP page
nodes.what: The page `umlimator.py mcp` serves, which an AI assistant drives with its page tools: `show_view`, `highlight`, `tour`, `play_story` and `clear`.
nodes.how: The server folds the assistant's commands into what the page should show, and sends that. The page shows it on the map's handle and posts its `MapState` back, which `page_state()` returns.

nodes.label: Navigation
nodes.what: A move from one view to another: `setView()`, a drill-down, up, a story's step, or a link.
nodes.how: One move at a time. A request during a move takes it to its own view, and every request's promise says whether its view was shown.

nodes.label: Story player
nodes.what: A story told step by step: `play()`, the page's Stories menu, or a link's `story=` and `step=`.
nodes.how: `player.state` is entering, playing or paused, then ended or stopped. A `story` event comes on each change. A move or a selection the story didn't make pauses it.

nodes.label: Tour and replay
nodes.what: One trip at a time: `tour()`, `replay()`, or a story step's tour.
nodes.how: Its promise is true when the dot reaches the end, and false when the trip is cut short.

nodes.label: MapState
nodes.what: The map's state as one snapshot: fresh, frozen and plain JSON on every read. The `state` event says which of its keys changed.
nodes.how: `handle.state`, the page's `window.umlimatorMap.state`, `<umlimator-map>`'s `el.map.state`, and the MCP tool `page_state()`.

nodes.label: At rest
nodes.what: A view is shown and no move is under way.

nodes.label: Leaving
nodes.what: The camera zooms into the card that opens the view, or out, and the view fades (130 ms). Skipped under reduced motion.

nodes.label: Drawing
nodes.what: The view asked for last is drawn, and the selection is cleared (a `select` event with `null`).

nodes.label: Entering
nodes.what: The camera zooms to fit the new view. A press on the map settles the glide, and the move goes on.

nodes.label: No story
nodes.what: `handle.story` is `null`. `play()` of a story the model lacks returns `null` and leaves the story shown.

nodes.label: Entering a step
nodes.what: The step's view, camera, selection and highlight are on their way. The `story` event comes first.

nodes.label: Playing
nodes.what: The next step comes once this one's time is up (4 s unless the step says) and its tour has ended.

nodes.label: Paused
nodes.what: `pause()`, ❚❚ on the bar, or the reader taking the map: a press, a wheel that zooms, a key, a view or a selection the story didn't make.

nodes.label: Ended
nodes.what: Past the last step: `next()`, ✓ on the bar, or the last step's time. `player.done` resolves `true`.

nodes.label: Stopped
nodes.what: `stop()`, ✕, Esc, `play(null)`, another `play()`, an `update()` whose model lacks the story, or `destroy()`. `player.done` resolves `false`.

nodes.label: No trip
nodes.what: No dot rides. `tour()` and `replay()` start one; a new one ends the one before.

nodes.label: Riding
nodes.what: The dot rides the line between each pair of cards in turn, and each card it reaches flashes.

nodes.label: Held
nodes.what: The page's ❚❚, a paused story (for its step's tour), or the replay's `pause()`.

nodes.label: Reached the end
nodes.what: `tour()` resolves `true`, and so does a replay's `done`; a replay's labels stay.

nodes.label: Cut short
nodes.what: Esc on the map, `tour(null)`, the next tour or replay, a new picture of the view, the replay's `stop()`, or `destroy()`.

nodes.label: Lit at rest
nodes.what: Under reduced motion no dot rides: the path is lit in the `tour` layer and said, and `tour()` resolves `true` at once. It stays until Esc, `tour(null)`, the next trip or a new picture.

nodes.label: An example, full size
nodes.what: An example shown full size, from a thumbnail in the details panel. It holds every key while open; Esc closes it and focus goes back to the thumbnail.

nodes.label: Search
nodes.what: Esc closes it and gives focus back; ⌘K (Ctrl K) closes it too.

nodes.label: The key list
nodes.what: One of search, the key list and the menus is open at a time.

nodes.label: A menu
nodes.what: Esc closes it and gives focus back to its button.

nodes.label: The view's popover
nodes.what: The popover of the view's pill.

nodes.label: The recorder
nodes.what: Export ▸ Record a story…: Esc closes it, asking first while it holds steps not saved.

nodes.label: A story
nodes.what: Esc or Backspace stops the story shown.

nodes.label: A tour or replay
nodes.what: Esc ends it and says so: “Tour stopped”, “Replay stopped”.

nodes.label: Up a level
nodes.what: Esc or Backspace with nothing selected goes up a level; at the top, the hint line says “Already at the top”.

nodes.label: A page tool
nodes.what: `show_view`, `highlight`, `tour`, `play_story` or `clear`. A view, card, line or story the model lacks is an error, and nothing is sent.

nodes.label: Folded
nodes.what: The latest of each, so a page that opens later shows what the assistant built, not its last command.

nodes.label: Sent
nodes.what: One event (Server-Sent Events) to each open page.

nodes.label: Shown on the page
nodes.what: The page shows each command once, one at a time; one that takes more than 5 s is answered as not shown.

nodes.label: Acknowledged
nodes.what: The page posts its `MapState` with the command's id, or the error that stopped it.

nodes.label: Answered
nodes.what: “Shown on 1 page at …, on view …”. Otherwise the tool says the page could not show it and why, that the open pages did not show it within 6 s, or that no page is connected and the URL to open.

views.title: umlimator's state machines
views.caption: The machines a host, a reader or an agent drives, and the state they all report. Double-click one for its states.

views.title: Navigation
views.caption: One move at a time, and the latest request wins. setView() resolves true once its view shows, else false.

views.title: Story player
views.caption: player.state: entering a step, playing or paused on it, then ended or stopped. A story event comes on each change.

views.title: Tour and replay
views.caption: One trip at a time. tour() and a replay's done resolve true at the end, false when cut short.

views.title: The page's keys
views.caption: Esc and Backspace close the top open layer first, in this order. On the map, Esc ends a tour or replay, then clears the selection, then goes up.

views.title: The MCP page
views.caption: A page tool, step by step: it answers “shown” only once a page has shown it.

steps.caption: An assistant calls show_view. The MCP page asks render()'s handle for the view.
The server folds the command into what the page should show and sends it. The page shows it and posts its MapState back, so the tool can answer “Shown on 1 page”.
On the page, the move leaves the view, draws the new one and zooms in. setView() resolves true, and one viewchange follows.
The reader plays a story: each step enters, then plays. A press on the map pauses it, and ▶ plays on.
A tour rides until the dot reaches the end: tour() resolves true. The page's ❚❚ holds it, and Esc cuts it short: false.
Esc closes the top open layer first: the story, then the tour, then the selection, then up a level.
Every change reaches MapState as one state event, and page_state() reads it back for the assistant.
